lessons.title: How 1C works: platform, service design and your data

sections.title: How 1C works: platform, service design and your data
sections.text:
How 1C works: platform, service design and your data
Distinguish platform, configuration and infobase using your own service desk.
Open an application and create a separate directory. No prior applied-course completion is required.
Identify three layers and the target of each change.
Open your own infobase in Designer and Enterprise mode.
Distinguish learning diagrams and highlighting from native execution.

sections.title: Three different things in one application
sections.text:
A service desk stores customers and repair requests. The 1C platform is installed software that displays windows, stores records and executes instructions. A configuration describes a particular application: its catalogs, fields, documents and actions. An infobase contains the application definition in use and its stored information. A notebook analogy helps initially: page structure resembles the definition and filled rows resemble data. A real infobase additionally maintains relationships, states and execution rules.
Renaming a customer changes one record; adding a document type changes the application definition. Two infobases can use identical configurations and contain different customers. Matching window titles therefore do not identify a working copy. Check the selected startup entry and its directory.

sections.title: Using the application or developing it
sections.text:
Enterprise mode is where users create and read records through application windows. Designer changes the definition and code. An empty infobase can have no Customers command because the catalog has not been defined. A missing command does not automatically mean the platform is broken.
We need no third-party accounting configuration. Exercises use our own service desk and invented data. First identify the right infobase; then create a small action with a visible result. The Start from zero link supplies official training-edition setup instructions before the first required launch.

sections.title: Program, instruction and module
sections.text:
A program describes actions in a particular order. An instruction is an individual action such as displaying a message. BSL is a common label for the 1C scripting language; .bsl identifies a module source-text file. A module belongs to a particular part of an application. A text file alone does not automatically create catalogs and forms.
Our first code lesson opens the managed application module in Designer and displays a message when the learner’s infobase starts. Saving source and executing it are different operations: update the database configuration and start the application after making changes. Exact buttons are explained before the first code task.

sections.title: Where execution really happens
sections.text:
Interactive Nexus diagrams explain relationships; switching them does not execute BSL. Studio syntax highlighting does not run it either. Install the official training platform normally on your computer for native practice. Obtain its distribution from the rights holder; the course transfers no licenses and requires no paid service for the beginner route.
The training edition supports our small file infobase but has limitations. It cannot establish server-cluster behavior, concurrent users or professional access protection. OneScript is a separate environment with a similar language, not an automatic replacement for the platform. Identify the environment and action actually observed.

Your training infobase: create, open and preserve a copy

sections.title: A directory and a startup entry are different
sections.text:
A file infobase resides in its chosen directory. A startup-list entry opens that location; the entry is not a backup. Renaming it does not move database contents. Removing an entry and deleting files also differ, so this lesson deletes neither. Choose a new directory whose purpose is clear, such as your personal training service desk.
Give copies explicit purposes: primary training, change experiment and restored check. Designer titles can show the same configuration name. Before restoration verify the selected startup entry and directory, not only the title.

sections.title: Create without a template or engineering script
sections.text:
In the startup list click Add, create a new infobase, then choose creation without a configuration for development. Name it My training service desk, keep placement on this computer and choose a separate directory. Do not use installed third-party templates. Keep other normal defaults unless the official instructions for your version require otherwise.
An empty infobase has no customers or documents yet. That is expected. The applied track will prepare a small original application; programming lessons gradually define their own objects. Neither Studio nor Windows Sandbox is required here.

sections.title: Formats preserve different things
sections.text:
A .cf file preserves the application configuration, not all entered customer records. An infobase dump .dt transfers infobase state. Definition files and module sources help development and comparison, but do not replace data backup. Choose by the content that must survive.
In your own Designer use Administration → Dump infobase. Choose a new dated .dt filename and wait for completion. A file existing is only the first check. Verify usability by loading it into another demonstrably empty infobase and comparing behavior.

sections.title: Restoration must leave the original intact
sections.text:
Close the original, create another empty infobase in a new directory and name it Training service desk — restore check. Start Designer from that verified entry. Load infobase replaces the target contents: cancel if you cannot establish that the target is the new empty copy. Do not experiment on your primary work.
Open the restored copy and repeat the available action. At this early stage compare structure; after entering customers compare codes, names and counts. A successful empty-base check does not prove preservation of future documents. Keep the original and backup separately. Nexus cloud state is not a backup of an external 1C infobase.

lessons.title: Your first program: a message when your infobase starts

sections.title: Your first program: a message when your infobase starts
sections.text:
Your first program: a message when your infobase starts
Enter a small handler in the correct module, update the infobase and observe native output.
Your own empty file infobase opens in Designer. Start from zero explains normal installation.
Explain the three lines of the first handler.
Distinguish saving, updating and starting the application.
Change the string and verify new output after another launch.

sections.title: From definition to action
sections.text:
The infobase has so far done nothing visible at startup. Add one action: display “Моя учебная служба работает” (“My training service desk works”). A message is immediately visible and needs no unexplained catalogs, arrays or functions. It creates no customers or documents. We are checking the specific chain from entered source to execution.
Enter the code in the managed application module. Select the configuration root, open its context menu and choose that module. Command placement can vary by version; use the managed application module, not an arbitrary common module. The platform invokes its startup handler when the application begins.

sections.title: Read the three lines
sections.text:
Процедура ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы() declares a startup-event handler. For now, know that the platform invokes it at application startup. Сообщить("Моя учебная служба работает"); displays the supplied text. Ordinary double quotes delimit the string and a semicolon ends the instruction. КонецПроцедуры closes the declaration.
The course explains the same Russian-spelling BSL source in English. Do not replace ordinary quotes with typographic ones. If the startup handler already exists, add the message inside it and preserve its other lines rather than declaring a duplicate handler.

sections.title: Three separate operations
sections.text:
Saving preserves configuration source. Updating the database configuration applies the definition used by the running application. Starting Enterprise mode invokes the handler. Ctrl+S alone therefore produces no new runtime message; starting without applying changes can execute an earlier version.
Use Ctrl+S, Configuration → Update database configuration (usually F7), then Debug → Start debugging (usually F5). Read proposed changes before accepting. A personal empty infobase gives no reason to accept deletion of someone else’s objects. Wait for startup and locate the application message area.

sections.title: A changed version and a negative control
sections.text:
After success change only the message text, save, update and launch again. A changed output links observation to the new source version. If the old text remains, check the intended infobase and completed update instead of rewriting unrelated modules. Keep the working version available for return.
In a separate copy, a missing closing quote should produce a syntax diagnostic. Restore it before execution. This negative control checks diagnostics and does not justify damaging the main training project. The result is an observation of your launch, not an automatic knowledge assessment.

lessons.title: Developer tools: diagnose an error and preserve a clear change

sections.title: Developer tools: diagnose an error and preserve a clear change
sections.text:
Developer tools: diagnose an error and preserve a clear change
Diagnose your own error, preserve a working version and distinguish tool purposes.
Distinguish saving source, updating the database configuration and execution.
Read the module and line in a diagnostic.
Repair the short source and repeat native execution.
Distinguish static analysis, source history and data backup.

sections.title: A development environment is not the runtime
sections.text:
Designer ships with the platform and is the reproducible P1 path. EDT is a separate Eclipse-based environment supporting projects and Git. It can target different platform versions and infobases, but running an application still requires the platform. Having an EDT project does not establish successful application to an infobase.
At the audit date the official website offers EDT 2026.2.2. We do not claim it is installed or tested with our workspace. Redistribution rights cannot be inferred from Eclipse licensing; the product and components need a separate check. Designer is sufficient for P1; EDT remains an optional additional validation path.
Designer from the official installation is sufficient for the first lessons. Do not install several editors for one message. EDT is a separate development environment useful for larger projects. BSL Language Server analyzes source statically. Git tracks source history. Their jobs differ: neither a commit history nor colored syntax proves application execution.

sections.title: Highlighting, BSL LS and OneScript
sections.text:
BSL Language Server supplies analysis and editor capabilities. Its LGPL license and diagnostics do not turn it into a 1C engine. The candidate does not integrate it and therefore makes no BSL LS static PASS claim. Native configuration checking is a separate executed mechanism with a version and negative control.
OneScript uses MPL-2.0 and executes an independent language implementation. It may support bounded language exercises but cannot stand in for 1C forms or registers. Neither OneScript nor BSL LS is added to mandatory Nexus startup. A provider/bridge decision needs 02/01 coordination and a threat model rather than a catalog flag change.
Read a diagnostic as an investigation coordinate: module or file, line and what was expected instead of the observed symbol. A missing quote can produce a message on the following line even though the cause is above. Compare the changed line with the last working one, correct one cause and repeat the check. Do not erase the handler merely to suppress diagnostics.

sections.title: Git preserves an explainable change
sections.text:
A commit should connect the problem, change and verification. Preserve sources, a concise protocol and safe evidence. Exclude working infobases, licensing files, personal connection parameters and installers. Reviewers need to see the changed module and the test expectations justifying it. Project commit messages are in Russian.
Avoid diverging copies of shared definitions. The course glossary is versioned and referenced by lessons, while learning results remain course-specific. A future shared-content update must not silently reinterpret a saved attempt; it needs a new version and compatibility review.
Preserve a working version before editing. A separate source-text file and change note suffice for the first small program. Git adds comparable history: change, reason and validation. Keep licenses, passwords, third-party infobases and real personal data out of source and commits. A source copy is not a .dt data backup.

sections.title: Diagnose from observation to hypothesis
sections.text:
When output is absent, first identify the completed stage: creation, loading, checking, update or execution. Then compare version, directory and source hash. File-access failure does not prove missing licensing; syntax failure does not prove a broken platform. State a narrow hypothesis that one safe experiment can falsify.
During author verification, access to a new infobase file was initially denied by the execution environment. The same operation on that same isolated workspace succeeded with permitted local access. We preserved the failed attempt and explanation without inventing a platform defect or touching production. Record problem → hypothesis → attempt → result → decision → regression.
Separate diagnostics before execution from result checking after it. Syntactically valid “30 - 45” is still wrong when a sum is required. Later tests will fix expected values; now repeat the known message and explain the observation’s scope. A disappeared error marker indicates corrected diagnostics, not automatic practice credit.

lessons.title: Your first calculation: variables, assignment and output

sections.title: Your first calculation: variables, assignment and output
sections.text:
Your first calculation: variables, assignment and output
Calculate the duration of two fictional service requests in installed 1C, explain each statement and change the calculation deliberately.
Install the official training edition of 1C:Enterprise. The lab guide explains installation and creating a new empty file infobase.
Be able to open your own training infobase in Designer and distinguish it from other infobases. The applied course is not a mandatory prerequisite.
Explain how assignment evaluates its right side before updating the variable on its left.
Put a short program in the correct procedure, update the database configuration and see 75 in 1C:Enterprise.
Predict 50 after changing one input, diagnose subtraction instead of addition and independently total three durations.

sections.title: The problem: calculate a total rather than print a prepared answer
sections.text:
The service desk has two requests, planned for 30 and 45 minutes. The dispatcher needs their combined duration: 75 minutes. Сообщить(75); would display that number, but would not calculate a total. Someone would have to recalculate manually whenever a request changed. Our program stores the two inputs and then computes the sum from their current values. These are fictional training requests, with no real customer information or money.
The program uses the 1C script language, commonly designated BSL in development tools. Read and analyze the lesson in Nexus, enter the source in Designer, and observe execution in the 1C:Enterprise window. The platform calls the application startup handler and displays the message. Nexus Studio can store sources, but is unnecessary for these four statements. Colored words in a browser do not mean that 1C has executed them.
Success is more than seeing one number once. Connect the inputs 30 and 45, the addition operation and the output 75. When the second input becomes 20, the same calculation must produce 50. This change distinguishes an actual calculation from a hard-coded answer. No statement here saves a catalog item or a document: screen output and persisted infobase data are different results.

sections.title: Assignment: evaluate the right side, then update the left
sections.text:
A variable names a value the program can use. In МинутыПервойЗаявки = 30; the identifier is on the left and the numeric literal is on the right. Assignment first evaluates the right side, then puts the result into the variable on the left. After this statement, МинутыПервойЗаявки holds 30. After the second, МинутыВторойЗаявки also holds 45. Track assigned values rather than assuming values that the program has not assigned.
The third statement has an expression rather than a single literal on its right side: МинутыПервойЗаявки + МинутыВторойЗаявки. The platform reads 30 and 45, adds them, and assigns 75 to ВсегоМинут. The fourth statement passes this value to the built-in Сообщить procedure. Displaying the value does not change the total. Moving the calculation before the input assignments would break the required order of actions.
МинутыПервойЗаявки is one identifier without spaces. Its readable parts help a person, but do not determine the type of the value. An unquoted 30 is a number; a quoted "30" is text. Both inputs in this lab must be numbers. A semicolon ends each statement. The argument to Сообщить goes inside parentheses. Copy identifiers as a whole: visually similar Cyrillic and Latin letters can form different names.

sections.title: Where the program belongs and why saving text is not enough
sections.text:
The managed application module contains code associated with the application as a whole. ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы is an event handler called by the platform when the application starts. Place the four statements between Процедура ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы() and КонецПроцедуры. These boundary lines are not part of the four-statement calculation, but provide its startup context.
A new empty infobase may not yet have this handler. The lab therefore provides the complete six-line module. If an infobase already contains your own handlers, preserve them and create a separate empty infobase for this first experiment instead of replacing its existing module. You do not need to save the four statements in Studio, export an archive and reload the source after every edit.
Saving in Designer preserves the editable configuration. The running application uses the database configuration, which must receive your changes before a new session starts. Close any open 1C:Enterprise user window, save in Designer, press F7 to update the database configuration, confirm the update if prompted, then press F5 to start. The training edition permits one simultaneous session; do not open multiple user sessions for this infobase.

sections.title: Test the idea by changing one input
sections.text:
Write your prediction before running: 30 + 45 = 75. Compare it with the platform message. Replacing 45 with 20 in the second statement changes only the second request duration. The third statement still adds the two variables, so the next saved, updated and restarted version should display 50. Restore 45 before the following experiment, keeping the inputs for each observation clear.
Consider the faulty expression ВсегоМинут = МинутыПервойЗаявки - МинутыВторойЗаявки; It is syntactically valid but solves a different problem. With 30 and 45 it produces −15. A syntax check need not reject a calculation that misunderstands the requirement. Comparing actual output with the expected 75 detects this error. Correct the operator, preserve the expected result, and rerun with the same inputs.
Extend addition by assigning a third duration, 15, to another variable and including it in the sum. The prediction for 30, 45 and 15 is 90. First repeat the worked example, then change one known input, and finally solve the independent task with 10, 25 and 5. This progression tests whether you can transfer the method to new values rather than merely copy a familiar statement.

lessons.title: Value types: why number 30 differs from text “30”

sections.title: Value types: why number 30 differs from text “30”
sections.text:
Value types: why number 30 differs from text “30”
Distinguish value types and explicitly convert suitable numeric text.
The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
Observe number and string types through ТипЗнч.
Preserve source text while obtaining a separate number.
Distinguish known zero, empty text and an unspecified value.

sections.title: Type and validity are separate
sections.text:
A type determines which operations make sense for a value. Number 30 represents a quantity; string "30" stores two characters. Similar display does not make them interchangeable. ТипЗнч reports a type without changing the variable; ТекстМинут remains a string afterwards.
-1 is numeric but invalid as our request duration. Zero is numeric and valid under the chosen rule. A variable name changes neither its type nor the requirement. Record input type, domain validity and expected action separately.

sections.title: Explicit conversion preserves meaning
sections.text:
Число(ТекстМинут) explicitly converts suitable numeric text. Store its result separately to compare the original representation and the new quantity. This promises no universal human-input parser: spaces, separators, units and empty input need an agreed rule.
ПреобразованныеМинуты = Число(ТекстМинут) obtains a new numeric value while preserving ТекстМинут. Keeping the original representation supports diagnosis and an explanation of acceptance. Do not calculate from arbitrary text with unknown units.

sections.title: Empty does not mean zero
sections.text:
Неопределено denotes an unspecified value in its context, not numeric zero or an empty string. An empty string already has a string type; zero already has a number type. ЗначениеЗаполнено can treat zero as unfilled, but that is not automatically the application rule for zero duration. Define the field’s meaning first.
Record three observations: numeric 0 has a number type; "" is a string; Неопределено is not a known duration. A technical filled-value predicate does not choose business rules. Replacing missing data with 0 can produce a plausible total while hiding the cause.

sections.title: Conversion boundaries
sections.text:
Check input type, then range and the intended operation. ТипЗнч output observes a type; result 45 observes arithmetic after conversion. Explain both independently. Handling invalid numeric text is covered with exceptions later; silently turning unknown input into zero hides an error.
Parsing "30" does not establish acceptance of "30 minutes", arbitrary separators or empty input. Those need a separate contract and rejection handling. Exception handling is covered later; do not claim universal validation from one accepted input.

sections.title: Conditions: choose an action and check boundaries
sections.text:
Conditions: choose an action and check boundaries
Build a decision table for a known numeric input and test branch ordering and boundaries.
The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: State the rule first
sections.text:
A condition has a Boolean answer, Истина or Ложь. Reject quantities below zero or above 1440 first. Among valid inputs distinguish zero, then quantities up to and including 60. The input is already known to be numeric; arbitrary text parsing is outside this rule.
Partition numeric inputs into four disjoint classes: outside 0..1440; exactly 0; 1..60; and above 60 up to 1440. This guides branches and boundaries. The main exercise assumes numeric type; do not promise string-input validation the source does not perform.

sections.title: The first matching branch
sections.text:
An Если/ИначеЕсли/Иначе chain chooses its first matching branch. Testing zero before <=60 preserves “Без затрат” (no time spent). With the range first, zero would already select “Короткая” (short), preventing the later zero branch.
Each branch assigns text to Класс; one message follows КонецЕсли. Later ИначеЕсли branches do not revise the chosen value. A trace includes tests that were never reached, explaining why order matters.

sections.title: And, or and negation
sections.text:
Или is true when at least one of the two limits is violated. A negative quantity and exceeding the upper limit are different invalid cases. Replacing Или with И is wrong: no number is simultaneously below zero and above 1440.
A И B requires both conditions; A Или B requires at least one; Не negates a Boolean. For a complex expression evaluate simple parts first, then combine them. Use parentheses to make intention explicit rather than depending on guessed precedence.

sections.title: A boundary counterexample
sections.text:
Test where the answer changes: -1/0, 0/1, 60/61 and 1440/1441. Input 30 alone cannot expose a missing boundary. Record which preceding conditions are false and which becomes true. This explains the branch rather than guessing from the final message.
Accidental <60 instead of <=60 fails at 60 while input 30 hides the error. Removing the upper rejection may classify 1441 as long. For each suspected mutation choose an input on which correct and incorrect programs differ.

lessons.title: Loops: repeat an action and explain every iteration

sections.title: Loops: repeat an action and explain every iteration
sections.text:
Loops: repeat an action and explain every iteration
Repeat a finite action, trace an accumulator and test no-iteration input.
The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
Separate initialization from body updates.
Trace 0 → 15 → 30 → 45.
Expose a reset error and explain termination.

sections.title: What repeats
sections.text:
A loop repeats instructions according to a rule. Для Номер = 1 По 3 assigns counter values 1, 2 and 3 in turn. Each value produces one body execution. КонецЦикла closes the repeated part; the message after it is displayed once after all iterations.
The body between Цикл and КонецЦикла executes for each counter value. Сообщить afterwards is outside it. Moving the message inside shows intermediate 15, 30 and 45 rather than one total: a different observation even if accumulation is unchanged.

sections.title: The accumulator invariant
sections.text:
ВсегоМинут accumulates the periods already included. It starts at zero before the loop, then becomes 15, 30 and 45. The invariant “after k iterations the total is 15 × k” explains intermediate states and exposes the first incorrect step.
Initially zero periods are included and total zero. One iteration includes exactly one period. After k iterations the total therefore covers k periods of 15 minutes. If the trace first differs at iteration two, investigate that transition rather than substituting the final output.

sections.title: Counter boundaries and no iterations
sections.text:
Setting ВсегоМинут = 0 inside the body erases preceding work on every iteration and leaves 15. It is syntactically valid but wrong for the total. Identify initialization and accumulation as different operations.
Range 1..4 adds four periods; range 1..0 executes no body and retains initial zero. A bound of zero does not create an extra iteration for zero. Пока checks before its body, so an initially false condition can also produce no iterations.

sections.title: Termination and later collections
sections.text:
The large engineering module remains supplementary. Execute this lesson’s short fragment with its own input and result. It tests in-memory arithmetic, not document persistence or database speed.
A finite Пока needs initialization, a test and a change approaching a false condition. Collections come later: Для Каждого traverses elements, but in-memory arithmetic is not automatically a document query. Прервать ends the loop; Продолжить skips the rest of one iteration.

sections.title: Numbers, dates and strings: separate value from presentation
sections.text:
Numbers, dates and strings: separate value from presentation
Separate values from presentation and explain units in date arithmetic.
The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
Obtain string 12.50 without changing the original number.
Construct a date from explicit calendar components.

sections.title: Quantity, presentation and unit
sections.text:
Number 12.5 stores a quantity; string "12.50" stores a chosen representation. A trailing display zero adds no precision to the numeric value. Format for a person or an agreed text interface, while calculations continue to use numbers rather than decorative strings.
Calculation value, displayed string and measurement unit are separate parts of an explanation. Displayed 12.50 alone says neither money, hours nor ratio. Стоимость is a training number here; real payments additionally require currency, rounding and an agreed operation meaning.

sections.title: Formatting is not input parsing
sections.text:
ЧДЦ=2 requests two decimal places, ЧРД=. selects a dot and ЧГ=0 disables digit grouping. These options govern this output only. They do not define a universal parser for financial input: currency, rounding and accepted representations are separate requirements.
Use ТипЗнч to compare the original number and resulting string when uncertain. Формат options govern the selected output. Parsing someone else’s string is another task whose representation may differ. A function name is no proof of universal locale support.

sections.title: Calendar components and seconds
sections.text:
Дата(2026,10,31,9,30,0) explicitly lists year, month, day, hour, minute and second. It avoids guessing the meaning of text such as 01/02. Adding 60 to this date adds seconds, not minutes; subtracting date values returns seconds.
Date components must form a valid calendar date, not merely six arbitrary numbers. October 31 exists; an impossible date must not silently become another date. The exercise fixes its start explicitly. Adding 60 changes time by one minute; crossing midnight also changes the day, so compare date and time together.

sections.title: Repeatability and scope
sections.text:
A time zone, calendar transition or business duration cannot be inferred merely from matching displayed dates. This short example checks arithmetic of the selected values. International exchange later specifies time representation and meaning explicitly. Use no external services or real payments in this exercise.
Record the exact start, addition in seconds, formatting string and actual messages. This example establishes no universal time-zone or international-exchange behavior. Later function and exchange contracts will be explicit, preserving input and errors without guessing.

Create an original common module, explicitly permit a server call and execute its exported function from an application handler.
onec.p2; P2: types, branching, loops and numeric boundaries.
Place each source fragment in its own intended module.

sections.title: Code location determines available data
sections.text:
The managed application module handles application events. Object modules belong to particular objects; form modules have form-specific data and context. A common module contains procedures and functions for other permitted callers. Identical procedure names in two modules do not create one shared implementation.
A cost formula may be needed by a form, a document and a report. Copying it into every place creates diverging implementations. A common module provides one calculation location but does not automatically receive the current form’s minutes. Pass minutes and the rate explicitly so identical inputs produce identical results.

sections.title: Two settings answer different questions
sections.text:
Экспорт makes the method callable from another permitted module. The common module properties determine execution contexts. This exercise enables Server and Server call and disables Managed application client, Global and Privileged. Return values reuse is DontUse. These are settings for this particular calculation, not a universal module template.
Server call exposes the module through the platform’s client-to-server mechanism. It does not create an HTTP API or bypass user rights. A file infobase still distinguishes logical client and server contexts; this exercise does not prove a separately deployed network server or license a training client-server installation.

If database access becomes necessary, isolate and name it explicitly and test it on an original synthetic dataset. Moving code into a common module alone does not make it pure or secure.

sections.title: Functions and parameters: return a cost while preserving the original minutes
sections.text:
Functions and parameters: return a cost while preserving the original minutes
Extract a cost calculation into a function with explicit inputs, a result and rejection of invalid values.
The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
Distinguish returning a value from displaying a message.
Trace arguments to parameters and preserve the caller’s numeric input.

sections.title: Give a reusable calculation a name
sections.text:
The same cost formula must serve different requests. A function is a named part of a program that accepts inputs and returns a value to the calling expression. Стоимость(30, 1200) passes 30 minutes and an hourly rate of 1200. The function does not need to know which screen supplied them.
A procedure performs an action; it does not return an expression value as this function does. Сообщить displays information to a person. Displaying 600 alone does not give the caller a number it can add to another cost. Here the function returns a number, the handler assigns it to Результат, and only then displays it.

sections.title: Arguments outside, parameters inside
sections.text:
Минуты and ТарифЗаЧас in the declaration are parameters. The caller’s variable and the literal 1200 are arguments for this call. Position determines their correspondence. Two numeric arguments can have the right type yet the wrong meaning. Minutes must be divided by 60 when the rate is hourly.
Знач on these numeric parameters keeps parameter assignments from modifying the caller’s variable by reference. It is not a promise of a deep copy of every mutable collection. Mutable data needs an explicit contract describing allowed changes and copying; the collections lesson develops that distinction.

sections.title: State the contract before the formula
sections.text:
This function accepts two nonnegative numbers, returns a cost rounded to two decimal places, and neither writes documents nor changes the caller’s duration. Type checks precede arithmetic; range checks precede calculation. Zero minutes is valid and costs zero in this particular exercise.
A negative duration raises an exception instead of silently becoming a free service. Returning zero for invalid input would hide an input error in a legitimate total. Callers must know both the valid result and the rejected inputs. A consistent result type on valid calls makes later calculations and tests easier.

sections.title: Declarations and execution are different

sections.title: Collections: order, named fields and lookup by key

Collections: order, named fields and lookup by key
Choose an Array, Structure or Map for its purpose and calculate a total while distinguishing order, fields and keys.
The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
Traverse different durations and explain the first array index.

sections.title: An array preserves a sequence
sections.text:
Our requests now take different durations: 30 and 45 minutes. Массив preserves a sequence. Добавить appends an element; the first index is 0, so МинутыЗаявок[0] is 30. There are two elements and the last valid index is 1.
Для Каждого visits the values in turn. The accumulator starts outside the loop: after 30 it is 30, after 45 it is 75. Reordering these numeric inputs changes traversal order but not their sum. An invalid index is an error, not a request for an imaginary zero.

sections.title: A structure names the fields of one record
sections.text:
Карточка has Клиент and Минуты fields. Карточка.Минуты communicates meaning more clearly than an arbitrary index. Structure field names must be suitable property identifiers. Several unrelated fields do not become a sequence of requests merely by being placed together.
The duration field receives the computed 75. This is an in-memory structure; creating it does not write a catalog item or database document. For an optional field, use Свойство("FieldName", Value) rather than assuming a misspelling returns an empty string.

sections.title: A map associates a key with a value
sections.text:
Соответствие is useful for lookup by key rather than position or a predefined field name. "Клиент-А" is an educational label here. A changeable customer name is not reliable identity in a real application; later lessons introduce catalog references. Inserting the same key replaces its associated value rather than appending a second array row.
Получить on a missing key returns Неопределено, which differs from a stored numeric zero. Do not add an unknown value to a duration without deciding what absence means. It might indicate that the total has not been calculated. Check the expected value and its type first.

sections.title: Two variables can name the same mutable object

A preservation check compares actual contents before and after, not just variable names. An empty array leaves this accumulator at zero under our chosen rule. A text value among numeric durations needs a different response: detect and reject it rather than trusting its numeric appearance.

sections.title: An operation may fail to produce a value
sections.text:
Число("30") produces a number; Число("ошибка") cannot perform the requested conversion. An exception interrupts the ordinary sequence. The remaining instructions in Попытка are skipped and control moves to Исключение. Результат = Истина is therefore not reached in the main example.
The initial flag is Ложь. It represents conversion success in this exercise only, not knowledge assessment, a saved document or permission to accept any number as a duration. Execution after КонецПопытки follows an explicitly chosen recovery path.

sections.title: Catch where you can provide a useful response
sections.text:
Keep the risky conversion in a narrow block. Combining many unrelated operations makes the failed action harder to identify. An empty exception handler hides a missing result while allowing the program to appear active.
A learner-facing message should explain the next action and give an example. Developers need reproducible steps and the failure location. Do not automatically publish raw diagnostics containing paths, records or connection details. This exercise retains its synthetic input in a local variable and sends nothing outside.

sections.title: Technical conversion is not business validation
sections.text:
The text "-1" can convert successfully. A negative duration still violates our service rule. Check the range after conversion; catching an exception does not replace that check or make an invalid value acceptable.
Distinguish unreadable text, a converted but unacceptable number, and an acceptable number. Zero can be valid under the chosen rule. Returning zero for every failure would erase the distinction between a known value and missing or rejected input.

sections.title: Make the failure reproducible

Record input, execution location, action, expected result and actual result. A synthetic string and short message suffice here; no full database, password or borrowed configuration is needed. A result from a different source version does not verify this experiment.
First run invalid text and observe the prompt and Ложь. Change only the input to "30": the prompt should disappear and the flag become Истина. Then investigate "-1" and specify the additional range check. This covers the recovery path and the ordinary path.

sections.title: A test asks a question with an observable answer
sections.text:
An “all good” message does not compare anything. ПроверитьРавно accepts the actual value, an independently calculated expectation and a case name. A mismatch raises an exception and prevents the success message. The case name identifies the broken agreement.
Calculate 600 for 30 minutes at 1200 per hour independently. Calling the same formula twice would allow the same error on both sides. Keep the business example separate from the implementation that must satisfy it.

sections.title: A small table checks different rules
sections.text:
Three numeric cases cover an ordinary calculation, allowed zero and a full hour. They do not cover every input or rounding rule. A one-hour case alone cannot expose every unit or rounding error. Choose additional cases from the contract, such as one minute or a fractional rate.
For the negative input, the rejection flag begins false, becomes true only on an exception, and is asserted afterward. An exception anywhere in a large program is not equivalent to the intended rejection. This exercise deliberately isolates one invalid call; professional tests also identify the expected rejection reason.

sections.title: State the scope of the evidence

This function neither reads database records nor depends on an open form or writes documents. Small isolated inputs can therefore test it. Rights, document persistence, UI and concurrent access require different scenarios in an appropriate environment.
Preserve the source, case table, successful result, incorrect copy and observed failure. A Nexus self-report stores the learner’s statement. Local execution alone is not server grading, proof of authorship or an official certificate.

sections.title: Customer identity: names change while references remain
sections.text:
Customer identity: names change while references remain
Use real catalog items to show that references establish identity and equal names do not merge customers.
onec.p3; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
Separate entity, reference, local code and readable name.

sections.title: Entity and key
sections.text:
A customer outlives one request. Its internal reference distinguishes it from another item even with the same name. An external code supports imports but needs its own uniqueness scope. Define which event creates a customer and which only updates the existing presentation.
The experiment creates two synthetic customers in a separate copy. The first is written, receives reference α, then changes name through the same object. A second object gets the same final name and a different reference β. Expect the original α after renaming and β≠α for the other item. These letters explain the trace and are not UUID values to enter. The check compares references rather than captions.

sections.title: Normalization is not a business decision
sections.text:
Trimming spaces and case normalization can help compare codes but may collapse distinct identifiers. Normalized names do not prove identity. Define a unique teaching codeC001 and reject collisions with a different entity. Repeating an import must not increase item count.
In this configuration Код is a nine-character string with a scope different from the internal reference. One catalog’s code is not a universal global key. Integration identifiers require an agreed source and scope; normalizing names does not establish that agreement. The equal-name records are intentional test objects, not an automatic assertion that they are one customer.

sections.title: References preserve relationships
sections.text:
A document stores a customer reference. Renaming should change presentation without breaking requests. Replacing the reference with a string loses relational identity and complicates updates. Key migration needs a mapping and checks of dependent objects; mass renaming alone is insufficient.
УчебныеДанные executes in the platform server context and is called by the managed application. In a file infobase that does not require a separate server computer. Server-call permission allows the 1C client to call an exported function; it neither publishes an internet HTTP endpoint nor replaces access rights. Leave privileged and global modes off.

sections.title: Verify idempotent creation
sections.text:
Seed twice and compare references, count and attributes. Add equal names with different codes to expose name-based lookup errors. Concurrent creation under one code needs a transactional solution; single-user repetition does not prove it. P10 addresses that boundary.
Every call creates two new items: this is a deliberate one-time experiment, not an idempotent customer import. Before repeating, record the created codes and expected growth. Do not use the original working base. The experiment distinguishes reference identity from names; merging records needs a separate rule and agreement.

sections.title: A reference is not an edit buffer
sections.text:
A reference identifies an item; obtaining its object provides editable state. Changing an object field in memory does not prove persistence. Two objects may reflect different read times. Do not save a stale object after another change without an agreed conflict strategy.
Model changes as well as creation. Customers can be renamed, services repriced, and requests can retain earlier agreed terms. List these events separately to identify catalog data, document snapshots and historical facts. This prevents silently updating every linked request when only current presentation or a current service offering should change.

sections.title: An empty reference is not an unknown string
sections.text:
A typed empty reference differs fromUndefined and an empty-name string. Existence checks follow the API and business rule. FindByCode does not create an absent item. Handle absence beforeGetObject so diagnostics identify the missing customer rather than a later incidental error.
Internal identity and external code solve different problems. References connect infobase objects; codes support imported correspondence. Define uniqueness scope, case handling and absence policy. Two systems can reuse one code for different customers, requiring sender scope or a mapping table. A name search alone cannot resolve this ambiguity safely or justify replacing an existing entity.

sections.title: Attribute reads have a cost
sections.text:
Reference access looks simple, but mass traversal can cause many calls. An object suits one card; reports across many rows often need a query selecting required fields. Do not infer performance from code appearance: count calls and measure equal datasets first. P7 examines queries in detail.
Keep empty references, missing items and deletion-marked objects distinct and define each outcome. An old request must not silently point to a newly created lookalike after reseeding. Compare identities and document relationships before/after; use labels only for human readability. A valid-looking card can otherwise conceal broken history or a duplicate entity.

Use an ordinary customer, an equal-named second customer and a request-free third customer. Test lookup, rename, reseed and selection. This set exposes implementations that only work when labels happen to be unique. Reopen the source separately afterwards: independent copies are proven by preserved records, not different labels in a launcher list.

Internal identity and external code solve different problems. References connect infobase objects; codes support imported correspondence. Define uniqueness scope, case handling and absence policy. Document lifecycle
Describe a document lifecycle and distinguish writing, posting and deletion marking.
onec.p4; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
Describe a document lifecycle and distinguish writing, posting and deletion marking.
Write a valid request without posting.

sections.title: Documents have state
sections.text:
A new object exists in memory before its first write. A written document has persisted fields and identity. A posted document additionally passed its configured accounting processing. Deletion marking is not physical deletion. Define commands and invariants for each state rather than treating UI as the lifecycle model.
Specify the complete document effect: its fields, dependent records, movements and external outcome. Separate preparation from acceptance. Checking one table cannot detect partial execution: a saved request without its movement may look individually valid while violating the accepted-order meaning. Define cross-object invariants before selecting handlers or adding transaction boundaries.

sections.title: A number does not replace identity
sections.text:
Numbers serve people, but numbering scope and periodicity depend on configuration. Use references for exact reopening. Two similar requests are not automatically duplicates. External request IDs need an explicit uniqueness policy; displayed document numbers alone are not a redelivery strategy.
Handlers run within platform-defined contexts; event names alone do not prove actual order. Trace entry, validation, cancellation and write. User messages are insufficient because they can precede final outcomes. Confirm through a fresh persisted-state read after completion and, for important cases, a new session. This distinguishes displayed intentions from committed business facts.

sections.title: Verify accounting effects separately
sections.text:
Posting may be unavailable in a starter configuration. EvenPosted=True does not specify required register records. Define business meaning and affected registers first, then link states to expected records. Document reports and movement reports answer different questions.
Repeating one intent differs from a new command with similar data. After an unknown outcome, do not automatically create another document; check the agreed prior-result key. Reposting an existing document replaces its own effect while preserving other recorders. Intent deduplication and movement replacement are distinct repeatability concerns requiring separate test cases.

sections.title: Test through a new session
sections.text:
Create, write without posting and reread. Then post in a suitable template, check movements and reverse posting. Reopen a session and compare states and identities. Name the exact configuration: posting results do not retroactively prove the earlyA2/P 2 stand supports posting.
Inject failures only on a separate instance at a deliberate point. Snapshot before the first modification and inspect every affected dataset after rejection. Then repeat without failure and verify no residue. Preserve a safe failed-experiment record before any cleanup; it explains cause and regression rather than concealing the defect behind a later successful attempt.

sections.title: Defaults are not validation
sections.text:
Defaults help create an object but do not validate later writing. Another form, exchange or programmatic call can change values. Separate convenient filling from mandatory validation. Customer, service and duration rules belong at a reliable write boundary; UI explains them to people.
Specify the complete document effect: its fields, dependent records, movements and external outcome. Separate preparation from acceptance. Checking one table cannot detect partial execution: a saved request without its movement may look individually valid while violating the accepted-order meaning. sections.title: BeforeWrite sees the object
sections.text:
BeforeWrite receivesCancel and document-writing parameters. It can enforce invariants and reject the operation. Do not reference a particular form’s controls: objects can be written without that form. Messages should identify invalid fields, but a missing message does not make a canceled write successful.
Handlers run within platform-defined contexts; event names alone do not prove actual order. Trace entry, validation, cancellation and write. User messages are insufficient because they can precede final outcomes. Confirm through a fresh persisted-state read after completion and, for important cases, a new session. This distinguishes displayed intentions from committed business facts.

sections.title: Handler repeatability
sections.text:
Repeated writing must not add another bonus document or accumulate customer minutes without an accounting rule. Side effects need idempotency and transactional linkage. Begin with input validation and add effects only under explicit requirements. Write identical data twice and compare every affected dataset.
Repeating one intent differs from a new command with similar data. After an unknown outcome, do not automatically create another document; check the agreed prior-result key. Reposting an existing document replaces its own effect while preserving other recorders. Intent deduplication and movement replacement are distinct repeatability concerns requiring separate test cases.

sections.title: Bypassing UI is a required control

Inject failures only on a separate instance at a deliberate point. Snapshot before the first modification and inspect every affected dataset after rejection. Then repeat without failure and verify no residue. Preserve a safe failed-experiment record before any cleanup; it explains cause and regression rather than concealing the defect behind a later successful attempt.

A movement explains which document caused an accounting fact. A service desk can track minute obligations by customer. A record contains period, dimensions, resource and recorder. A document’sMinutes field is not itself a movement. Agree on sign and meaning before implementing a handler.

Handlers run within platform-defined contexts; event names alone do not prove actual order. Trace entry, validation, cancellation and write. Transaction and refusal
Verify transactional atomicity of related changes and safe rejection.

Verify transactional atomicity of related changes and safe rejection.
Perform two related writes without failure.

sections.title: One business fact needs one decision
sections.text:
If a request and dependent record must appear together, do not accept them independently. A transaction groups changes into commit or rollback. It does not make the algorithm correct or replace validation. Identify all affected data and require either complete consistency or the previous state.
Specify the complete document effect: its fields, dependent records, movements and external outcome. Separate preparation from acceptance. Checking one table cannot detect partial execution: a saved request without its movement may look individually valid while violating the accepted-order meaning. Define cross-object invariants before selecting handlers or adding transaction boundaries.

sections.title: Boundary and lifetime
sections.text:
Keep explicit transactions short and finish every path. Do not wait for users, network or long reports while holding a transaction. Some platform operations already have a transactional context; understand the call site before nesting another boundary. A nested start is not an independent backup.
Handlers run within platform-defined contexts; event names alone do not prove actual order. Trace entry, validation, cancellation and write. User messages are insufficient because they can precede final outcomes. Confirm through a fresh persisted-state read after completion and, for important cases, a new session. This distinguishes displayed intentions from committed business facts.

sections.title: Preserve the original failure
sections.text:
On exception, roll back the transaction you started and propagate the failure with safe diagnostics. Do not continue as if successful. Rollback cannot undo actions outside the transaction, especially files and external requests. Those need another coordination and idempotency protocol.
Repeating one intent differs from a new command with similar data. After an unknown outcome, do not automatically create another document; check the agreed prior-result key. Reposting an existing document replaces its own effect while preserving other recorders. Intent deduplication and movement replacement are distinct repeatability concerns requiring separate test cases.

sections.title: Choose a failure point
sections.text:
In a separate copy, inject failure between two related writes. Reopen a session and compare both tables after rejection. Then run the valid operation and expect exactly one effect. A before-state snapshot is essential because test setup itself may have changed the baseline.
Inject failures only on a separate instance at a deliberate point. Snapshot before the first modification and inspect every affected dataset after rejection. Then repeat without failure and verify no residue. Preserve a safe failed-experiment record before any cleanup; it explains cause and regression rather than concealing the defect behind a later successful attempt.

sections.title: Facts by key
sections.text:
An information register suits rates by service and time. Service is a dimension, rate a resource, and period adds history. An attribute stores extra description rather than replacing the key. Start from “which rate applied toS1 atD”; one current card price cannot answer the historical question.
Choose a register from the data question. “Which rate applied?” needs keyed temporal state;“how much was delivered this week?” needs turnover;“what obligation remains?” needs balance. sections.title: Periodicity limits distinguishable states

Two records for one service in one period follow the key policy. Daily periodicity cannot distinguish two intraday changes under the same key. Do not substitute current time just to bypass a collision. Choose required precision and test exactly at a rate-change boundary.
Dimensions define slices, resources measured quantities, and recorders provenance where supported. Adding a dimension changes keys and granularity: customer totals may split by service. Define old-data treatment and grand-total reconciliation before restructuring. Time boundaries belong in specifications. State uses an as-of moment, turnover an interval, and movements an agreed period. Test before the first fact, exactly at a change and after it. Equal totals without matching identities do not prove correctness: errors for different customers can cancel numerically while allocations remain wrong.

sections.title: A repeatable transformation
sections.text:
Posting transforms the current document into a movement set. Identical input should yield an equivalent set regardless of repetition. Compare dimensions, resources, periods and recorder—not merely one total. Opposite duplicates can cancel numerically while leaving invalid records.
Choose a register from the data question. “Which rate applied?” needs keyed temporal state;“how much was delivered this week?” needs turnover;“what obligation remains?” needs balance. Dimensions define slices, resources measured quantities, and recorders provenance where supported. Adding a dimension changes keys and granularity: customer totals may split by service. sections.title: Failures must not mix versions

Failure between removing old and writing new records must not leave a partial effect. Inject failure only in a new copy and test atomicity. Reread document/register in a fresh session. Transactions and locks address different concerns: one change’s consistency versus interacting concurrent changes.
Time boundaries belong in specifications. State uses an as-of moment, turnover an interval, and movements an agreed period. Test before the first fact, exactly at a change and after it. Equal totals without matching identities do not prove correctness: errors for different customers can cancel numerically while allocations remain wrong.

sections.title: A query expresses a set
sections.text:
1C query language addresses the metadata model, not arbitrarySQLfor modifying internal tables. SELECT chooses fields, FROM defines the source, andWHERE defines conditions. Begin with expected identities and values rather than selecting everything and hoping to understand later.
Every query starts with a set specification: row granularity, required fields, scope, identities and multiplicity. Reconcile a small source set manually. Syntax correctness cannot detect lost customers or multiplied sums. Inspect identities and types before totals, which may match accidentally when two defects compensate. Keep this independent oracle beside every query revision.

sections.title: Pass values as parameters
sections.text:
Do not concatenate customer names or dates into query text. SetParameter supplies a typed value separately from structure. A customer reference is not its display string. A parameter cannot stand in for an arbitrary field name: choose structure from an allowlist and keep user values parameterized.
Parameters separate structure/values without defining business meaning automatically. References, names and external codes differ. Dates carry time and agreed boundaries. Choose dynamic fields from a structural allowlist, not user text. Specify each parameter’s type, empty-value policy and an example yielding zero rows without changing data. This tests the contract rather than parser acceptance alone.

sections.title: Periods have precise boundaries
sections.text:
UseDate>=Start ANDDate<End for an agreed half-open interval. IncludeStart and excludeEnd. A daily query must account for document time. Ordinary rows do not expose a last-second error; add records exactly on both boundaries.
Joins and aggregation affect multiplicity differently. Joining two detail sets can multiply rows; grouping can hide the cause behind one wrong sum. Inspect intermediate membership before resources. Respect virtual-table semantics/parameters and temporary-table context/lifetime. Neither mechanism is a universal optimization trick. Explain which problem it solves and verify equivalent values before measuring speed.

sections.title: Result and cursor differ
sections.text:
Execute returns a query result; Select creates traversal; Unload materializes a value table. Choose by volume and needed operations. An empty result is not inherently an error. Reconcile identities, types, count and sum, then verify reading did not modify documents.
Compare performance only after equivalence. Freeze data, versions, call count, cache conditions and repeated timing. A small local experiment does not establish field p95. Reject speedups caused by dropped rows or permission checks. Preserve rejected variants, reasons and the correct baseline so later optimization does not repeat a known defect. Report observed metrics without broadening their scope.

A temporary table stores intermediate results within an execution context and can support reuse. It is not a persistent catalog. Specify fields, keys and expected multiplicity. Materializing all columns or all source rows can hurt performance; select only required data with justified filtering.

Form data and object
Separate managed-form data from the infobase object when saving a request.

Separate managed-form data from the infobase object when saving a request.
Compare form-data and object types.

sections.title: Forms hold a representation
sections.text:
A managed form has attributes and controls; an application object has logic and persisted state. Form values can be intermediate and unsaved. Equal field names do not create one variable in every context. Trace where minutes came from and when they become a persisted document value.
A managed form is an interaction boundary, not the only data source. Values occupy form buffers, objects and persisted records at different times. Trace read, edit, transfer and write to identify unsaved snapshots. Refresh must not silently replace user input with another request’s state. Distinguish visible values from accepted business state throughout the workflow.

sections.title: Conversion is explicit
sections.text:
On the server, FormAttributeToValuecan obtain an application object from a suitable form attribute. Returning data also requires proper conversion. Do not assume form data exposes every object method. Identify actual type and allowed context rather than moving everything to the client to silence an error.
Context determines available operations and required inputs. Pure calculations need numbers; document reads need identity and an available server environment; focus handling needsUI. Do not pass whole forms instead of designing minimal contracts. Specify serialized inputs, outputs and reliable-side validation independently of client hints. Context availability and permission authorization remain separate concerns.

sections.title: UIvalidation does not protect writes
sections.text:
The form may highlight bad ranges before submission, but the object boundary must enforce mandatory rules. Client data can become stale between read and write. Important operations need an agreed server-side version/state check. A new screen must not bypassP5preservation rules.
Bind asynchronous actions to a specific intent/version. Users can close forms, edit data or start another operation while awaiting replies. Late responses must validate relevance before acting. UIcancellation does not promise rollback of committed server work. Separate pending, accepted, unknown, rejected and canceled states with distinct verification scenarios rather than one ambiguous success flag.

sections.title: Test two routes
sections.text:
Create a valid request through the form and programmatically; outcomes should agree. Submit invalid data by both routes. Reopen and compare fields. If presentation is stale, refresh it through the agreed event rather than rewriting the database merely to synchronize the screen.
Test both expected and unexpected event ordering: delays, double-clicks, cancel and closing with unsaved input. Reconcile effect count and database state through fresh reads. File-mode compilation of client directives proves only that context; it does not measure network routing, physical mobile acceptance or isolatedStudioBSLexecution. Record these boundaries so successful checks are not overstated.

Button handling, focus and dialogs belong toUI. Infobase access and reliable rules belong in an available server context. Thick and thin clients differ; local success does not prove a distributed design. Specify the target client and permitted operations before implementation.

sections.text:
Do not send every customer to obtain one total. A server method receives minimal typed inputs and returns required data. The client cannot provide trusted permission or price decisions; the server checks its own conditions. Test serialization and parameter types separately from arithmetic correctness.
Context determines available operations and required inputs. Pure calculations need numbers; document reads need identity and an available server environment; focus handling needsUI. sections.title: A file infobase is not a network

sections.title: A schema describes data
sections.text:
DCS separates data description, settings, layout and output. A schema defines datasets, fields, relationships and parameters. TheMinutes resource specifies aggregation rather than merely a numeric column. Define dataset granularity and a three-document expectation before using a designer.
Define the question and granularity before composition. Customer-minute sums, average document cost and open-request counts need distinct resources/denominators. Similar-looking reports are not interchangeable. Use uneven groups and independent calculations to expose averaging/grouping errors that symmetric toy examples can hide. Check underlying identities before interpreting the final visual representation.

sections.title: Resources depend on granularity
sections.text:
An already customer-grouped dataset can be summed again only with correct multiplicity. A bad join doubles resources beforeDCS. Check raw query rows before report groupings. A computed field with a nice name cannot repair lost or extra records.
Schema describes available data, settings select retrieval/presentation, and output produces a result. Changing one level does not silently authorize changing another. Record parameters, variant, time and units. Saved settings usually are not frozen data snapshots; new documents can legitimately change the same variant. Preserve membership and observed values for reproducibility as well as the configuration of the report.

sections.title: Settings differ from the source set
sections.text:
One schema can support multiple report variants. Users change available fields, filters and groupings without silently gaining forbidden data scope. Check permissions and dataset restrictions separately. Preserve variant and parameters so another reviewer reproduces the same question.
External components and exports cross distinct boundaries. Processors execute code and need provenance, authority and environment checks. Printed files present data under edition constraints. In-memory generation is not actual saving or printing. Explain unavailable capabilities honestly; circumventing platform limits is not an acceptable educational workaround. Preserve source records when output fails or cancellation occurs.

sections.title: Accept from source evidence

Trace each report row to source facts. Verify membership/units, then aggregation/presentation. A deliberately wrong filter in a copy must alter the expected result and be detected. Repeat ordinary, empty and boundary datasets after correction. This demonstrates test sensitivity rather than merely generating a plausible screen once without a runtime error.

Similar-looking reports are not interchangeable. Use uneven groups and independent calculations to expose averaging/grouping errors that symmetric toy examples can hide. sections.title: Number and formatting differ

Schema describes available data, settings select retrieval/presentation, and output produces a result. Changing one level does not silently authorize changing another. Record parameters, variant, time and units. Saved settings usually are not frozen data snapshots; new documents can legitimately change the same variant. Preserve membership and observed values for reproducibility as well as the configuration of the report.

sections.title: Edition controls availability
sections.text:
Training edition restricts runtime spreadsheet-document printing/saving. Check the exact build and official terms rather than promising every client an export. Use another permitted original reconciliation protocol where needed. Do not bypass limits with patches or call a screenshot a proven document export.
External components and exports cross distinct boundaries. Processors execute code and need provenance, authority and environment checks. Printed files present data under edition constraints. In-memory generation is not actual saving or printing. Explain unavailable capabilities honestly; circumventing platform limits is not an acceptable educational workaround. Preserve source records when output fails or cancellation occurs.

sections.title: Test by rereading output

Trace each report row to source facts. Verify membership/units, then aggregation/presentation. A deliberately wrong filter in a copy must alter the expected result and be detected. Repeat ordinary, empty and boundary datasets after correction. This demonstrates test sensitivity rather than merely generating a plausible screen once without a runtime error.

sections.title: Individually correct, collectively wrong
sections.text:
Two operations each read balance 10 and spend 7. Each passes alone; combined balance−4breaks the rule. A post-read check without coordinated locking does not prevent the second transaction. Starting a transaction alone does not specify lock scope. Draw read A→readB→write A→writeBbefore choosing anAPI.
Engineering quality follows invariants, not absence of exceptions. Balance uses admissible amounts, permissions authorized scope, diagnostics explainable failure without leaks. Specify what survives errors and concurrent actions. Positive cases prove utility; negative cases prove boundaries. Denying everything is not a universally correct security implementation. Evidence needs both operational success and correctly bounded rejection.

sections.title: Locks apply to data
sections.text:
Managed locking identifies a data space and dimension values. Lock invariant-related data before deciding. Too-wide locks reduce concurrency; too-narrow locks miss conflicts. Scope depends on register, mode and operation; there is no universal line suitable for every solution.
Transactions, locks and authorization solve different problems. Atomicity coordinates one operation, locking interacting operations, and rights constrain subjects. None proves the others. Identify decision point, read data and authorized actor for each failure scenario. Choose minimal protection rather than enabling every capability or broadening privileges. A context compile check is not a multi-user access proof.

sections.title: Consistent ordering reduces deadlocks
sections.text:
Two operations locking A/Bin opposite order can deadlock. Agree on stable-key order and keep transactions short. A timeout is failure, not a successful spend. Retrying needs idempotency and a fresh state read; blindly repeating external effects can duplicate them.
Measurement/observability must preserve privacy. Use synthetic IDs, bounded logs and defined metrics. Passwords/tokens are unnecessary even for leak demonstrations; use canaries. One timing is not p95, and one profile result does not cover every role/configuration combination. Keep raw diagnostics restricted and publish only sufficient sanitized evidence tied to the actual test environment.

sections.title: First steps: platform, application and your infobase
sections.text:
First steps: platform, application and your infobase
Find or install a lawful training platform, open your own empty infobase and explain why an empty application window is the correct first result.
Be able to open a folder and a text file in Windows.
No ready-made 1C application configuration is required.

sections.title: One brand, several different things
sections.text:
“Install 1C” is an incomplete specification. The platform supplies common mechanisms: windows, infobase access, module execution and data operations. A configuration describes a domain: which customers, requests and services exist, what can be saved and how results are calculated. An infobase holds a particular application instance and its data. Several infobases can use one installed platform. A shortcut label therefore does not establish that the intended infobase is open.
In our service desk, Request as a future document type belongs to the configuration. Request REQ-001 from invented customer Alpha is data. Version 8.3.27.2214 identifies the platform. Confusing these layers can make you mistake a software update for a data transfer or submit configuration sources instead of completed work. Separate the layers before making your first change.
Think of a text editor: the installed program is not the same thing as your document. Similarly, one 1C platform installation can open several independent infobases. In this course, Training service desk is the application we build ourselves, not a third-party product to download. We begin with our own empty infobase; customers and requests appear after we define their objects.

sections.title: What an application contributes
sections.text:
The platform does not inherently know what “request closed” means. The application defines that rule. Identical words in different configurations may represent different actions. Saving generally persists an object state; posting reflects a business event according to configuration rules. Posting does not automatically mean payment or completion. A1 establishes vocabulary and a model; actual catalogs and documents are introduced in later modules.
The learning model contains three requests lasting 30, 45 and 30 minutes. Their sum is 105 minutes, but this is not yet revenue, employee workload or paid labor: we have not defined those rules. A careful user checks the meaning, unit and selection behind a metric before drawing conclusions. This habit is more useful than memorizing button positions.
A beginner has two separate questions: which application window am I using, and what has already been created in my infobase? The title and launch command answer the first. Configuration and saved data answer the second. Instructions for a different accounting or payroll application need not match an empty training infobase: commands, business rules and protected objects can differ.

sections.title: A lawful training environment
sections.text:
The main free route uses the official version for learning programming supplied by 1C. If a suitable platform is already lawfully installed, first check its version and suitability for your own training infobase. Do not copy keys, licenses or third-party configurations. The conditions of the chosen distribution apply whether you launch it from a shortcut or another tool.
The training edition is for learning and has limitations. These labs do not demonstrate a multi-user deployment, password-based access protection or real business operations. Begin with a file infobase, one session and invented records. Nexus does not redistribute the platform: obtain it from its rights holder. A professional environment is considered separately when a task actually needs one.

sections.title: Record a result that can be checked
sections.text:
Record the application name, a safe infobase alias and the full platform version separately. A configuration version does not replace a platform version. An unlabeled screenshot does not explain the operation tested. A concise protocol includes the action, expected result, observed result and limits of the conclusion.
Without an installed platform, you can study theory and classify items with the interactive diagram. This is useful preparation, but it is not 1C execution. Diagram buttons explain a model; they do not create an infobase or execute BSL. Attest a laboratory step only after observing it in the official environment.
The first observable result is deliberately concrete: your infobase appears in the startup list, Designer displays a metadata tree, and Enterprise mode opens without application sections. An empty window is normal because we have not described the application yet. Marking the lesson complete in Nexus records your self-report; it does not create a configuration or install the platform.

sections.text:

Choose a mode for a task and distinguish user settings, records and configuration changes.
Your own empty training infobase from the previous lesson.
